meta.title: Mochirii Monthly Raffle
meta.intro: Mochirii holds monthly drawings for eligible guild members. No raffle is active and no submissions are being accepted.

entryModel.standardEntrySummary: One eligible monthly opt-in provides five standard entries.
entryModel.bonusEntrySummary: Members may earn up to five optional bonus entries through the standing participation methods below. Each method provides no more than one bonus entry per drawing.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Guild activity
permanentBonusMethods.primaryPath: Check in for one scheduled guild activity.
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or complete the monthly pulse poll.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Monthly gathering
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or send an asynchronous agenda response.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Member support
permanentBonusMethods.primaryPath: Join or host one party or help session.
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or privately share availability for a future guild group.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Shared knowledge
permanentBonusMethods.primaryPath: Share one useful guild tip or resource.
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or answer the rotating knowledge question.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Guild feedback
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or complete the end-of-cycle feedback prompt.

noAdvantageRules: Completing both paths in one pair never earns two bonus entries.
Alternative-response text is used only to verify completion, reduced to non-reversible evidence, and then discarded.
Purchases, payments, donations, and subscriptions never improve entry counts or odds.
Referrals, invitations, follows, public shares, daily logins, and early entry never improve entry counts or odds.
The maximum is ten entries per person in one drawing.
entryModel.oddsFormula: A member's valid entries divided by all valid entries after the drawing closes.

rewards.summary: Drawing rewards may include electronic gifts, approved in-game gifts, and two Mochirii community honors.
rewards.activeDrawingNotice: Each active drawing identifies the exact primary reward, value, eligible locations, delivery method, redemption terms, and available choices in its official rules.

categories.title: Electronic gifts
categories.description: Digital gift cards, virtual prepaid rewards, or other eligible electronically delivered choices described in the active drawing rules.

categories.title: In-game gifts
categories.description: Approved in-game gifts described in the active drawing rules.

categories.title: Guild commendation
categories.description: A community honor recognizing a member's contribution to the guild.

categories.title: Hall record
categories.description: A community honor recorded with the completed drawing for guild members to remember.

eligibility: Verified Mochirii guild member in good standing, age 18 or older, resident of a country approved for that drawing, and limited to one account and one opt-in per person per cycle.
standingPrinciples: No purchase necessary. A purchase or payment never improves the chance of selection.
Published odds are a member's valid entries divided by all valid entries after the drawing closes.
Each drawing has separate official rules stating its dates, eligibility, reward, value, claim period, expiration, and any location restrictions.
Each completed drawing confirms one primary winner, two community-honor recipients, and predetermined alternates without replacement.
Potential winners must retrieve rewards through the authenticated Mochirii claim page within seven days after the drawing unless the active drawing rules lawfully require a different period.
Private claim reminders may be sent when approximately 72 hours and 24 hours remain.
Electronic rewards expire 30 days after issue unless the active drawing rules lawfully state a different term.
Signed-out visitors see only Winner confirmed or Community honor confirmed. Authenticated guild members may see each recipient's selected guild display name.

results.emptyMessage: No completed drawing result is available.
